Voxel-Based Procedural Terrain Generation | PDF | Voxel | Rendering ...
This dissertation by Stefan Petrov Kopanarov explores procedural terrain generation using voxels, focusing on performance and visual impact of various techniques. A tool was developed in Unity that implements methods such as Perlin noise, Simplex noise, and Marching Cubes, allowing for comparison and optimization of terrain generation.
